title: Rate Year, Computation Date and Reserve Account Terms (Employer UI Tax Accounts)
content:
Rates on Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts run for a calendar rate year. Reserve balances and payroll are measured on 30 June each year for the next rate year, and the rate notice for that next year is mailed no later than 15 December.

## Terms by financing class

| Financing class | Computation date | Rate year | Rate notice mailed by | Payroll years averaged | Credited to the reserve | Benefit charges posted |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Contributory — New Employer Standard Rate | June 30 | Calendar year | December 15 | 3 | Contributions paid | Quarterly |
| Contributory — New Employer Construction Rate | June 30 | Calendar year | December 15 | 3 | Contributions paid | Quarterly |
| Contributory — Experience-Rated Positive Reserve | June 30 | Calendar year | December 15 | 3 | Contributions paid | Quarterly |
| Contributory — Experience-Rated Deficit Reserve | June 30 | Calendar year | December 15 | 3 | Contributions paid | Quarterly |
| Contributory — Delinquent Reporting Assigned Rate | June 30 | Calendar year | December 15 | 3 | Contributions paid | Quarterly |
| Reimbursing — Nonprofit Organization | June 30 | Calendar year | December 15 | 3 | Not applicable — no reserve account | Not applicable |
| Reimbursing — Governmental Entity | June 30 | Calendar year | December 15 | 3 | Not applicable — no reserve account | Not applicable |

## Meaning of each term

- **Computation date** — the date each year at which reserve balances and payroll are measured for the next rate year.
- **Rate year** — the period a rate applies to; here, the calendar year from 1 January to 31 December.
- **Rate notice mailed by** — the latest date each year by which the notice for the next rate year is mailed.
- **Payroll years averaged** — the number of fiscal years ending on the computation date whose taxable payroll is averaged in the reserve ratio: 3.
- **Credited to the reserve** — what goes into the reserve account: contributions paid, for contributory classes.
- **Benefit charges posted** — how often benefit charges are posted to the reserve account: quarterly, for contributory classes.

**Illustration of the calendar (hypothetical rate year 2027).** Reserve and payroll are measured as of 30 June 2026; the 2027 rate notice is mailed on or before 15 December 2026; the rate applies from 1 January 2027 to 31 December 2027. The three payroll years averaged are the fiscal years ending 30 June 2024, 30 June 2025 and 30 June 2026.
